label: YS-30
title: Phase-4 prefund integer truncation: principalToWithdraw rounds down by up to 1 wei, potentially delivering less than shortfall to the staker
description: `principalToWithdraw = (shortfall * minterBooked) / minterRealizable` (line 456) uses Solidity integer division which truncates toward zero. In the below-par case (minterBooked > minterRealizable), the disposed shares deliver principal * (minterRealizable/minterBooked) ≈ shortfall minus truncation dust. In the above-par case (minterBooked < minterRealizable), the same truncation applies and may deliver slightly less than shortfall in underlying terms. The code emits a WARNING when `injected < shortfall` (lines 475-477) and requires `injected > 0` (line 473) but does NOT hard-revert on a 1-wei shortfall. The comment at lines 433-434 states the Phase-5 `staker_realized == staker_booked` assert is the 'ultimate gate' — but that gate does not exist (see finding 75e4305a). A consistent 1-wei per-pool shortfall is dust-level; however, in combination with the absent ultimate gate, any shortfall (even 1 wei) propagates silently through Leg2 as a user principal haircut.
impact: Up to 1 wei per pool under-delivery propagates into the V2 strategy as a shortfall in user principal. Combined with the absent ResetAndRewire post-assert (finding 75e4305a), this creates a silent user haircut path. In isolation the dust is immaterial; systemically it removes the machine-enforced safety guarantee. Must be fork-confirmed before broadcast.
recommendation: Add rounding-up adjustment: `principalToWithdraw = (shortfall * minterBooked + minterRealizable - 1) / minterRealizable` (ceiling division). This ensures the disposed shares deliver at least `shortfall` underlying rather than at most. Also add the missing `staker_realized == staker_booked` gate in ResetAndRewire.s.sol (finding 75e4305a). Fork validation of the exact delivered amount is required before mainnet broadcast regardless.
relatedNote: Combined with finding 75e4305a (absent ultimate gate), this creates a systemic silent user haircut path. Fix both together.
